text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor f-r-a-m-e-d the e-x-h-i-b-i-t as a f-i-l-e-d r-e-c-o-r-d i-n-s-t-e-a-d of a l-i-v-e d-e-m-a-n-d, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n m-e-t-a d-a-t-a t-r-a-c-e, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-e-d-a-c-t-i-o-n s-t-a-t-u-s c-o-n-f-i-r-m-a-t-i-o-n.
2) the t-e-a-m a-p-p-l-i-e-d the h-y-p-h-e-n a-t-e-d l-e-t-t-e-r f-o-r-m a-c-r-o-s-s e-v-e-r-y w-o-r-d s-i-x l-e-t-t-e-r-s or l-o-n-g-e-r, c-r-e-a-t-i-n-g a v-i-s-u-a-l f-o-r-e-n-s-i-c a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t, w-h-i-l-e o-m-i-t-t-i-n-g the c-o-n-s-i-s-t-e-n-c-y r-e-v-i-e-w p-a-s-s.
3) they d-e-l-i-v-e-r-e-d the f-i-n-a-l s-t-r-u-c-t-u-r-e d-u-r-i-n-g the c-l-o-s-e-d d-r-i-l-l, r-e-t-a-i-n-i-n-g a p-e-r-m-a-n-e-n-t t-r-a-n-s-c-r-i-p-tion s-n-a-p-s-h-o-t, y-e-t b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g the t-o-n-e a-n-d s-t-y-l-e v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p.
4) the g-r-o-u-p v-e-r-i-f-i-e-d the o-p-e-n-i-n-g s-t-a-m-p m-a-t-c-h-e-d the r-e-q-u-i-s-i-t-e f-i-r-s-t t-o-k-e-n, g-e-n-e-r-a-t-i-n-g a t-e-m-p-o-r-a-l-y l-o-g g-e-n-t-r-y, a-n-d f-o-r-g-o-t-t-e-n the f-o-r-m-a-t-a-b-l-e c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e a-u-d-i-t.
5) the e-x-e-r-c-i-s-e c-o-n-c-l-u-d-e-d with a c-l-e-a-n h-o-u-s-e l-o-g a-n-d n-o a-c-t-i-v-e r-e-q-u-e-s-t h-a-n-d-l-e-d, p-r-o-v-i-d-i-n-g a d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-e-d c-l-o-s-u-r-e r-e-p-o-r-t, b-u-t s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the s-e-c-u-r-i-t-y i-m-p-a-c-t s-c-o-r-e-c-a-l-c-u-l-a-t-i-o-n.
